body.p: In document 575216, Acoustic Noise Mitigation Guidance refers to an option of setting "AP threads Idle Manner" to "RUN Loop" in BIOS setup menu.
Per Section 2.2 in this document, EDKII update has the "AP threads Idle Manner" PCD in the code for AP wait loop state selection.
To select :"Run Loop", configure the PCD value to '2' as example shown below:
## Specifies the AP wait loop state during POST phase.
# The value is defined as below.
# 1: Place AP in the Hlt-Loop state.
# 2: Place AP in the Mwait-Loop state.
# 3: Place AP in the Run-Loop state.
